summary: Social Image Generation feature fully tested and working. Backend endpoint /api/v1/agents/{agent_id}/social-card.svg returns valid 1200x630 SVG with agent stats, tier badge, and RepLedger branding. Frontend PublicAgentPage correctly uses social-card.svg for og:image and twitter:image meta tags.

backend: Social card displays tier (Silver, Unrated, etc.)
Social card includes RepLedger branding and reputationledger.dev URL
Social card returns 404 for non-existent agent
Unrated tier social card uses correct gray color (#4B5563)
Silver tier social card uses correct color (#9CA3AF)
Social card has tier glow effect
Social card has card shadow effects
Social card is publicly accessible without authentication
frontend: og:image meta tag uses social-card.svg URL
twitter:card set to summary_large_image (for large preview)
og:title, og:description, og:url, og:type, og:site_name all set correctly
Page displays agent stats (score, success rate, outcomes, tier)

critical_code_review_comments: Implementation is clean and follows OG/Twitter card best practices
SVG generation includes all required visual elements (gradient, grid, glow, shadows)
Tier colors are correctly mapped for all tiers (Unrated, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum)
Note: JSON-LD structured data still uses badge.svg for image (line 102 in PublicAgentPage.jsx) - this is acceptable as JSON-LD is for search engines, not social sharing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Social card SVG generation feature fully implemented and tested. Backend generates 1200x630 SVG with gradient background, grid pattern, tier glow effect, stats cards (score, success rate, outcomes), large tier badge, and RepLedger branding footer. Frontend uses social-card.svg for og:image and twitter:image meta tags with summary_large_image card type for large social media previews.
